comment: Audited CPython interpreters whose bundled native files and incorporated third-party code are mapped to byte-exact upstream texts. Only listed interpreter builds are supported; anything else fails the runtime build. Regenerated by a development-only assembler from verified scratch evidence; it reproduces upstream text and grants no licence. Microsoft runtime files are recorded for identity only and remain an owner review gate.
